recent.name: Perception leaf — cross-family confidence study + leaf-novelty pre-reg (v2)
recent.what: Audited empirical study: does the two-axis confidence + per-capacity-calibration leaf-contract generalize? Synthetic scoring/retrieval/derivation + real-data FrameNet frame-disambiguation. Findings (CROSSFAMILY_PREREG §10/§11): both axes generalize beyond perception, but WHICH axis carries correctness is family-dependent (selection→decision, entailment→grounding); two-axis independence requires proposer≠critic; per-capacity calibration is CONDITIONAL (only under incommensurability); near-vocab blind-spot is continuous-substrate-ONLY (absent in discrete); grounding = inverse-critic anchored at a REFERENCE (floor=perception special case). Real-data = TRUSTWORTHY-PARTIAL (decision transfers qualitatively, risk-coverage 6.5x; AUROC degrades synth 0.83→real 0.745). PIVOT (user-driven): the confidence work is ORTHOGONAL to the real MindsOS novelty; designed (pre-registered, NOT built) the LEAF-NOVELTY test = learned-but-NAMED-atom leaves + irreducibility→request-atom→one-shot-repair vs a strong CNN+OOD baseline at noise-parity.
